meta.title_en: Gentrification and Social Mixing: Towards an Inclusive Urban Renaissance?
meta.title_zh: 绅士化与社会混合：迈向一场包容的城市复兴？
meta.byline: Loretta Lees · Urban Studies, 45(12), 2449–2470 (2008) · 本页为全文节选：最后两条批判 + 结论（原文 pp. 2462–2465）

items.en: Critique 5 — Social Mix Policy Fails to Demonstrate How ‘Social Mixing’ between Diverse Neighbourhood Groups is Going to be Achieved
items.zh: 批判之五 —— 社会混合政策从未说明，不同街区群体之间的“社会混合”究竟要如何实现

items.en: Social mix policies fail to demonstrate how ‘social mixing’ between diverse neighbourhood groups is actually going to be achieved. The assumption is that if you place middle-class people side-by-side with poor people, they will make the decision to mix and thereby start mixing. Yet, as discussed earlier, Butler with Robson (2003) have argued that the spatial proximity of middle-class and working-class groups in gentrified/fying neighbourhoods does not automatically generate neighbourhood-level social mixing (see also Freeman, 2006; Davidson, under review).
items.zh: 社会混合政策从未说明，不同街区群体之间的“社会混合”实际上要如何达成。其预设是：只要把中产阶级和穷人并排安置在一起，他们就会作出混合的决定，混合于是开始发生。然而，如前文所论，Butler 与 Robson（2003）主张，在已绅士化／正在绅士化的街区中，中产阶级与工人阶级群体在空间上的邻近，并不会自动生成街区层面的社会混合（另见 Freeman, 2006；Davidson，审稿中）。

items.en: Other, much earlier, sociological literature seems to back this up. Much of the sociological literature in the 1960s/1970s was concerned with the consequences of ‘affluence’ on the class structure and specifically whether the working-class were becoming middle-class. In a definitive critique of the affluence debate, Goldthorpe et al. (1969) dismissed any simple economically assimilationist explanation. They argued that not only would the working class have to acquire middle-class economic status, but they would also have to demonstrate similar cultural and social behaviours. Critically, they argued the working class would have to be accepted by the middle class—i.e. there would need to be a normative as well as a social and economic dimension to social mixing.
items.zh: 另一批年代久远得多的社会学文献，似乎也支持这一点。1960—70 年代的大量社会学研究，关注的是“富裕化”（affluence）对阶级结构的后果，尤其是工人阶级是否正在变成中产阶级。在对这场“富裕化辩论”的一次决定性批判中，Goldthorpe 等人（1969）否定了任何简单的经济同化式解释。他们主张，工人阶级不仅必须获得中产阶级的经济地位，还必须表现出相似的文化与社会行为。而关键在于，他们主张：工人阶级还必须被中产阶级所接纳——也就是说，社会混合除了社会与经济维度之外，还必须有一个规范性（normative）维度。

items.en: They concluded that, while there was evidence of economic convergence, there was little evidence of social and normative convergence. It was not simply that the middle class did not want to accept the affluent working classes into their communities, there was little evidence that the affluent workers wanted to join them. The community studies literature of the same period pointed to a similar social, cultural and spatial segregation.
items.zh: 他们的结论是：虽然存在经济趋同的证据，社会与规范层面趋同的证据却很少。而且，问题并不只是中产阶级不愿意把富裕起来的工人阶级接纳进自己的社区——同样几乎没有证据表明，富裕起来的工人想要加入他们。同一时期的社区研究文献，也指向了类似的社会、文化与空间隔离。

items.en: The government’s mechanisms designed identify how the rhetoric of social mixing via gentrification will be converted into a strong neighbourhood social tissue. [Column-break damage in source.]
items.zh:
政府所设计的机制⋯⋯辨明经由绅士化而来的社会混合修辞，将如何转化为坚实的街区社会肌理。
［原文此处分栏错位，语义不全——此句在纸本中应有缺失成分，请以出版商版本核对］

items.en: Critique 6 — What Kinds and How Much Social Mixing — And Why — Are Often Poorly Specified
items.zh: 批判之六 —— 究竟需要何种、多少社会混合，以及为什么，政策文献往往语焉不详

items.en: Precisely what kinds and how much social mixing are best for fostering an inclusive urban renaissance—and why—are often poorly specified in the policy literature (Randolph and Wood, 2003). For instance, in his testimony to the Select Committee on Environment, Transport and Regional Affairs (2001, para 33), Labour MP Nick Raynsford maintained that
items.zh: 究竟哪一种、多大程度的社会混合最有利于培育一场包容的城市复兴——以及为什么——在政策文献中往往被交代得很含糊（Randolph and Wood, 2003）。举例来说，工党议员 Nick Raynsford 在向环境、交通与地区事务特别委员会作证时（2001，第 33 段）主张：

items.en: the division between areas exclusively of owner occupation and exclusively of renting, which was very much a creation of the 20th Century, has not been a happy one in our view, and led to social polarisation and social exclusion. We believe that new developments should contain a mix of housing.
items.zh: 在我们看来，纯自有住房区域与纯租赁区域之间的分割——这在很大程度上是二十世纪的产物——并不是一件好事，它导致了社会两极化与社会排斥。我们相信，新开发项目应当包含混合的住房类型。
items.attrib: Nick Raynsford 工党议员 (2001) 证词原话，经 Lees 转引——这是 Lees 用来展示政策话语含糊性的被批判对象，不是她本人立场。注意此处政策语言只说“应当混合”，却未界定混合什么、混合多少。

items.en: The then Deputy Prime Minister John Prescott signed approvingly: “Our social mix is geared to achieve that” (para 33). However, empirical research suggests that the effects of tenurial diversification (mixing) are often disappointing and always context-dependent (Atkinson and Kintrea, 2001; Wood, 2003). In addition, policy documents that promote social mixing fail to define what a ‘good’ social mix is, or what kinds of communities are well balanced [column-break damage] social mix is merely a description that may apply to virtually any urban neighbourhood. No neighbourhood has a completely homogeneous population (Goodchild and Cole, 2001, pp. 103–104).
items.zh: 时任副首相 John Prescott 表示赞同：“我们的社会混合正是为达成这一点而设计的”（第 33 段）。然而，经验研究表明，业权多元化（即混合）的效果往往令人失望，且始终依赖于具体语境（Atkinson and Kintrea, 2001；Wood, 2003）。此外，倡导社会混合的政策文件，从未界定什么才算“好的”社会混合，或什么样的社区才算均衡⋯⋯［原文此处分栏错位］⋯⋯社会混合不过是一个几乎可以套用于任何城市街区的描述而已。没有哪个街区的人口是完全同质的（Goodchild and Cole, 2001, pp. 103–104）。

items.en: Without governments asserting what kinds of social mix are required (for example, percentages and types—such as income, class, age, ethnicity, tenure) in urban communities, it is difficult to assess just what kinds of change in neighbourhood character—such as changing ethnicity or class composition—are intended to aid neighbourhood communities in bringing about an urban renaissance. […] to increase social mixing, placing poor and middle-class people cheek-by-jowl, may therefore prove ineffective in increasing social mixing.
items.zh: 如果政府不明确指出城市社区中究竟需要哪一类社会混合（例如比例与类型——收入、阶级、年龄、族裔、业权），那就很难评估：街区特征上的哪些变化（比如族裔构成或阶级构成的改变），才是被寄望于帮助街区社区实现城市复兴的。⋯⋯因此，那些旨在增加社会混合、把穷人与中产阶级紧挨着安置的做法，在增加社会混合这件事上，可能被证明是无效的。

items.en: These six critiques force us to ask the question: is gentrification-induced social mixing a good thing? Goodchild and Cole (2001) considered the question whether social mixing was a good thing by asking whether greater neighbourhood social diversity actually increased interaction between the rich and poor, and whether social mix improved the quality of life for neighbourhood residents. If we ask these same questions of gentrification-induced social mixing, then the evidence discussed here says no.
items.zh: 这六条批判迫使我们追问一个问题：由绅士化所诱发的社会混合，是一件好事吗？Goodchild 与 Cole（2001）在考察“社会混合是否是好事”时，提出的追问方式是：更高的街区社会多样性，是否真的增加了富人与穷人之间的互动？社会混合是否改善了街区居民的生活质量？如果我们把同样的问题拿来问“由绅士化所诱发的社会混合”，那么本文所讨论的证据给出的答案是：不。

items.en: Conclusion
items.zh: 结论

items.en: Socially mixed urban communities created by the in-movement of middle-class people into poor, marginal areas of the inner city are being posited, under the rubric of urban renaissance, as the desegregating answer to lives that are lived in parallel or in isolation along class, income, ethnic and tenurial fault lines. It is ironic that a process that results in segregation and polarisation—gentrification—is being promoted via social mix policies as the ‘positive’ solution to segregation. By abstractly celebrating formal equality under the law, the rhetoric of social mixing tends to conceal the inequalities of fortune and economic circumstance that are produced through the process of gentrification.
items.zh: 由中产阶级迁入内城贫困、边缘地带所造就的社会混合型城市社区，正在“城市复兴”的名目下，被设定为一剂去隔离的解药——用以对治那些沿着阶级、收入、族裔与业权断层线各自平行、彼此隔绝地过着的生活。而讽刺之处在于：一个本身导致隔离与两极化的过程——绅士化——正通过社会混合政策，被推销为解决隔离问题的“正面”方案。社会混合的修辞，通过抽象地颂扬法律面前的形式平等，往往遮蔽了绅士化过程所生产出来的财富与经济境遇上的不平等。

items.en: Social mix policies rely on a common set of beliefs about the benefits of mixed communities, with little evidence to support them, and a growing evidence base that contradicts the precepts embedded in social mix policies that should make policy-makers sit up and take note. As Cheshire (2008) argues, a mixed communities policy is essentially a faith-based policy since there is scant real evidence that making communities more mixed makes the life-chances of the poor any better.
items.zh: 社会混合政策依赖于一套关于混合社区好处的共同信念，而支持这些信念的证据极少；与此同时，与社会混合政策所内嵌的那些信条相矛盾的证据基础却在不断增长，这本应让政策制定者警醒。正如 Cheshire（2008）所论，混合社区政策本质上是一种信仰式政策（faith-based policy），因为几乎没有真实证据表明，让社区变得更混合，能让穷人的人生机会变好哪怕一点。

items.en: Social mix policies are cosmetic policies rather than ones prepared to deal with the whole host of complex social, economic and cultural reasons as to why there are concentrations of poor, economically inactive people in our central cities. As Cheshire (2006, p. 1241) argues
items.zh: 社会混合政策是化妆式（cosmetic）的政策，而不是准备去应对那一整套复杂原因的政策——即，为什么我们的中心城市里会出现贫困、经济上不活跃人口的集聚。正如 Cheshire（2006, p. 1241）所论：

items.en: forcing neighbourhoods to be mixed in social and economic terms is treating the symptoms of inequality, not the cause ... on a par with applying leeches to lower a fever
items.zh: 强迫街区在社会与经济意义上变得混合，是在治疗不平等的症状，而不是病因⋯⋯这与用水蛭放血来退烧无异。
items.attrib: Cheshire (2006: 1241) 原话，经 Lees 转引——Lees 认同并借用此论断。“用水蛭退烧”是全文最锋利的比喻，可直接引用。

items.en: Deprivation, like gentrification and social exclusion, is a process, not a condition. And the evidence outlined earlier suggests that over the longer term poor people suffer more from the loss of benefits of living in a poor neighbourhood, than they gain from living in a more affluent one. This leads Cheshire (2008) to suggest that efforts to improve social equity would be more effective if directed towards people themselves rather than moving people around to mix neighbourhoods. Indeed, the neighbourhood itself needs to be re-evaluated (see also Galster, 2007) as the locus of these policies; neighbourhoods are not static but dynamic entities.
items.zh: 贫困剥夺（deprivation）与绅士化、社会排斥一样，是一个过程，而非一种状态。而前文列出的证据表明：从更长的时段看，穷人因失去“住在穷街区所带来的好处”而蒙受的损失，大于他们因“住进更富裕街区”而获得的收益。这使 Cheshire（2008）提出：若要改善社会公平，把力气直接用在人身上，会比把人搬来搬去以混合街区更有效。事实上，作为这些政策着力点的“街区”本身，就需要被重新评估（另见 Galster, 2007）——街区不是静态的，而是动态的实体。

items.en: Social mix policies also destroy, in my mind, their moral authority (see Blomley, 2004) because they socially construct the middle class or middle-income groups as a natural category in contrast to a demonised working class or low-income groups (and this is done spatially). They push the idea that we all should somehow be/become middle class and that we all want to be middle class. They are about social engineering (social cleansing) and all the problematic connotations that go with that. They forge a relationship between property and propriety, owner-occupiers are well behaved and ‘normal’, whilst social tenants are problematic and abnormal—they are ‘othered’.
items.zh: 在我看来，社会混合政策还摧毁了它们自身的道德权威（见 Blomley, 2004）：因为它们把中产阶级或中等收入群体在社会意义上建构成一个自然的范畴，与之对照的则是被妖魔化的工人阶级或低收入群体——而这一建构是通过空间完成的。它们推销这样一种观念：我们所有人都理应以某种方式成为中产阶级，而且我们所有人都想要成为中产阶级。它们所做的是社会工程（社会清洗），以及随之而来的一切成问题的含义。它们在“财产”（property）与“得体”（propriety）之间锻造出一种关联：自有房产者行为良好、是“正常的”，而社会住房租户则是麻烦的、不正常的——他们被“他者化”了。

items.en: In this paper, I have forged the beginnings of an evidence base from which to reject the policy ideas about gentrification and social mixing outlined in this paper, but further research is needed. For those who find it difficult to throw the concept of social mixing overboard, future research needs to compare more systematically, interviewing or surveying both gentrifiers and non-gentrifiers living in the same neighbourhoods, social mixing in neighbourhoods at different stages of gentrification (see Rose, 2004).
items.zh: 在本文中，我已着手锻造一个证据基础的雏形，据以拒斥文中所述那些关于绅士化与社会混合的政策观念；但仍需进一步研究。对于那些觉得难以把“社会混合”这一概念整个抛弃的人来说，未来研究需要更系统地进行比较：访谈或调查居住在同一街区的绅士化者与非绅士化者，比较处于绅士化不同阶段的街区中的社会混合情形（见 Rose, 2004）。

items.en: For, as Butler and Lees (2006) have suggested, pioneer gentrifiers tend to be pro-social-mixing whilst contemporary (third- or fourth-wave) gentrifiers tend not to be of the left liberal variety; they are more individualistic and prefer sanitised and relatively homogeneous neighbourhoods. If these are the middle-class people through whom New Labour (and other governments) want to promote social mixing, then it will be stonewalled.
items.zh: 因为，正如 Butler 与 Lees（2006）所提示的：先锋型绅士化者往往支持社会混合，而当代的（第三波或第四波）绅士化者则往往不属于左翼自由派那一类——他们更个人主义，偏好经过净化、相对同质的街区。如果新工党（以及其他政府）指望通过这批中产阶级来推动社会混合，那么这件事将被硬生生挡回去。

items.en: We also need to look at neighbourhoods that demonstrate different types of gentrification, for as Butler with Robson (2003) have shown neighbourhood context can be directly correlated with typologies of gentrifiers (in terms of politics, lifestyles, etc.)—a gentrifier in Brixton is quite different from a gentrifier in Barnsbury or Docklands, and their views on social mixing will be quite different too. Debates are taking place in the absence of a significant knowledge base as to how social mix is experienced on a day-to-day basis within the different contexts of gentrification in our cities. It is our responsibility as gentrification researchers to create the evidence base needed to refute or revise the claims of policy-makers about gentrification and social mixing as an inclusive form of urban renaissance.
items.zh: 我们还需要考察那些呈现出不同类型绅士化的街区，因为正如 Butler 与 Robson（2003）所展示的，街区语境可以与绅士化者的类型学（在政治、生活方式等方面）直接相关联——布里克斯顿（Brixton）的绅士化者与巴恩斯伯里（Barnsbury）或码头区（Docklands）的绅士化者相当不同，他们对社会混合的看法也会相当不同。当下的种种争论，是在缺乏一个重要知识基础的情况下展开的：即，在我们城市中不同的绅士化语境里，社会混合在日常层面究竟是如何被经验到的。作为绅士化研究者，创造出足以驳斥或修正政策制定者主张（即把绅士化与社会混合说成一种包容式城市复兴）的证据基础，是我们的责任。

items.en: It is worth mulling over Susan Fainstein’s ideas about ‘the just city’ here
items.zh: 此处值得反复琢磨 Susan Fainstein 关于“正义之城”的看法：

items.en: The new urbanist approach of intermixing a variety of building types and levels of affordability ... is not the panacea that some of its supporters assume. If, however, it becomes the template for infill development (rather than the formula to justify the destruction of public housing) it can provide a physical framework for a city that offers a higher quality of life to residents and visitors. Developing an appropriate physical setting for a heterogeneous urbanity, however, can go only so far in the generation of a just city. Most crucial is a political consciousness that supports progressive moves at national and local levels towards respectfulness to others and greater equality.
items.zh: 新城市主义那种把多种建筑类型与多档可负担水平混合起来的做法⋯⋯并不是其某些支持者所设想的万灵药。然而，如果它成为填充式开发（infill development）的模板，而不是被用来为摧毁公共住房提供正当性的公式，那么它确实能为一座城市提供一个物质框架，使居民与访客获得更高的生活质量。不过，为异质性的都市生活营造出合适的物质环境，对于生成一座正义之城而言，所能达到的程度终归有限。最关键的，是一种在国家与地方层面支持进步举措、朝向尊重他者与更大平等迈进的政治意识。
items.attrib: Fainstein (2005: 16) 原话，经 Lees 转引——Lees 认同并引为出路。请特别注意括号中那句“而不是被用来为摧毁公共住房提供正当性的公式”：这正是把混合业权模板用于拆除公屋区（如 Waterloo、Elephant and Castle）时，最直接的批判依据。

items.en: For those committed to throwing neighbourhood-based social mix policies overboard, as they are currently framed, we need to come up with some alternative ideas. How can we frame a socially inclusive urban renaissance? We can learn some things from the work on the just and the ideal city, work that seems to have been forgotten along the way. Iris Marion Young’s (1990) defence of the politics of difference is important in the face of the above critiques of social mix policies.
items.zh: 对于那些决心把当前形式的、以街区为基础的社会混合政策整个抛弃的人来说，我们需要提出一些替代性构想。我们该如何构想一场社会包容的城市复兴？我们可以从关于“正义之城”与“理想之城”的研究中学到一些东西——这些研究似乎在一路上被遗忘了。面对上述对社会混合政策的种种批判，Iris Marion Young（1990）对“差异政治”（politics of difference）的辩护，就显得相当重要。

items.en: Young accepts the domination of specific neighbourhoods by single groups, as long as the boundaries between these neighbourhoods remain blurred (fuzzy borders or fuzzy boundaries). In her ideal of city life, there is group differentiation and the interfusion of these groups occurs through social space. It is an openness to unassimilated otherness (see Lees, 2004, ch. 1). She highlights the need to provide spaces (not neighbourhoods) that offer opportunities for social interaction amongst people from different social backgrounds (see also Lofland, 1998). The problem with this is that on the surface it accepts the gentrified neighbourhood in its own right.
items.zh: Young 接受特定街区由单一群体所主导——只要这些街区之间的边界保持模糊（fuzzy borders／模糊边界）。在她理想的城市生活图景中，存在群体分化，而这些群体的交融是通过社会空间发生的。这是一种对“未被同化的他异性”（unassimilated otherness）的开放（见 Lees, 2004, 第 1 章）。她强调，需要提供的是空间（而非街区），以为不同社会背景的人提供社会互动的机会（另见 Lofland, 1998）。这一思路的问题在于：它表面上等于承认了已绅士化街区本身的正当性。

items.en: My feeling is that if people prefer to live with people like themselves we should not be forcing them to mix, because ultimately this will fail; rather, we should be keeping the possibility for mixing open to them. This means a refocus on urban design, disallowing fortress-style architecture and gated communities and rethinking the architecture of insecurity and fear. For as Atkinson (2006, p. 831) argues, it would appear that governments espouse social mix policies that “preach the value of integration” at the same time as they facilitate “residential changes of voluntary disaffiliation” that “surely damage” future prospects for civic vitality in cities. Yet it also means remaining critical of the process of gentrification and in particular of state-led policies of gentrification that are trying to socially engineer, dare I say socially cleanse, our central cities (see Lees et al., 2008).
items.zh: 我的感觉是：如果人们偏好与自己相似的人住在一起，我们就不应当强迫他们混合，因为这最终会失败；相反，我们应当为他们保留混合的可能性。这意味着重新聚焦于城市设计：不允许堡垒式建筑与门禁社区，并重新思考那种以不安全感与恐惧为底色的建筑学。因为正如 Atkinson（2006, p. 831）所论，政府看起来一面拥护那些“宣讲融合之价值”的社会混合政策，一面又在促成“自愿脱离式的居住变迁”，而后者“必定损害”城市未来的公民活力前景。但这同时也意味着：要对绅士化过程保持批判，尤其是对那些试图对我们的中心城市进行社会工程改造——我甚至敢说是社会清洗——的国家主导型绅士化政策保持批判（见 Lees et al., 2008）。

glossary.term: 社会混合（social mix / social mixing）
glossary.def: 指通过住房与规划政策，让不同收入、阶级、业权（自有／租赁）、族裔的人口在同一街区中共居的政策取向。其官方论证通常是：混合可以打破贫困集聚、减少隔离、让低收入者获得“榜样”与社会网络。本文的整体目的就是拆解这一论证：Lees 指出它缺乏证据基础、并且实际上被用来为绅士化提供正当性。读你自己的案例时要注意：赫尔辛基的反隔离话语、悉尼 Waterloo 的 30/20/50 业权比例，都是这一政策家族的成员。
英国新工党时期的核心城市政策话语，源自 1999 年由建筑师 Richard Rogers 领衔的“城市工作组”（Urban Task Force）报告。它主张通过致密化、棕地开发与混合社区，让中产阶级回到内城。Lees 的标题以问号结尾（“迈向一场包容的城市复兴？”）正是在质疑：这场复兴究竟对谁包容。
指住房的产权与占用形式——自有（owner-occupation）、私人租赁、社会／公共租赁、以及各类中间形式。“业权混合”（tenure mix）是社会混合政策最常见的操作化手段：因为政府无法直接规定谁住哪里，就转而规定各类业权的比例。Waterloo 的“30% 社会 + 20% 可负担 + 50% 市场”正是一个业权混合指标。Lees 的批判要点是：业权比例的改变，并不等于社会互动的发生。
1960—70 年代英国社会学的一场核心争论：随着战后工资上涨，工人阶级是否正在“变成”中产阶级（即所谓 embourgeoisement／资产阶级化命题）。Goldthorpe 等人（1969）的《富裕工人》研究给出否定答案：经济上确有趋同，但社会与规范层面没有。Lees 把它搬出来，是为了指出社会混合政策正在重犯半个世纪前就已被证伪的假设——以为经济上的并置会自动带来社会融合。

加拿大地理学家（西门菲莎大学），研究财产权、法律与城市空间的关系，著有《城市之未安：城市土地与财产政治》（Unsettling the City: Urban Land and the Politics of Property, 2004）。Lees 借他来说明：社会混合政策通过把“财产”与“得体”捆绑，在道德上把自有房产者建构为正常、把社会住房租户建构为问题——这正是政策丧失道德权威之处。你在赫尔辛基论文（Yrjänä 2026）里也会遇到 Blomley 被引用于同一论点。
对“社会工程”（social engineering）的一个刻意尖锐的改写，指以政策手段系统性地更换某一地区的人口构成。Lees 在文中两次使用并明确说“我甚至敢说”（dare I say），表明这是有意为之的政治性措辞，用以剥去政策的中性外衣。引用时要注意这是作者本人有意选择的强词，不是中性描述。

1994—2010 年间 Tony Blair 与 Gordon Brown 领导下的英国工党，其意识形态基础是 Anthony Giddens 的“第三条道路”。其城市政策以“城市复兴”“可持续社区”“混合社区”为核心词。Lees 与 Davidson 都指出：正是这套听起来进步的中间偏左修辞，让国家主导的绅士化得以被包装成社会改善。这是把 Lees 与 Davidson 两篇接起来的关键节点。
由美国规划理论家 Susan Fainstein 发展的规范性框架，主张以公平（equity）、多样性（diversity）与民主（democracy）三项标准来评价城市政策，而非仅以增长或效率。Lees 引它作为社会混合的替代出路。对你的 Waterloo 论文而言，Fainstein 引文中那句“而不是被用来为摧毁公共住房提供正当性的公式”是可直接引用的批判武器。

美国政治哲学家，著有《正义与差异政治》（Justice and the Politics of Difference, 1990）。她反对把“融合”当作理想，转而主张一种承认群体差异、但保持边界模糊（fuzzy boundaries）、允许群体在社会空间中交融的城市理想。Lees 借她提出一个重要转向：应当提供促成互动的空间，而不是强行规定混合的街区——但同时也坦承这一思路有承认已绅士化街区正当性的隐患。
